summary.text: Maurice West has represented the 67th District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2019.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography says West was born in 1985 in Elgin and attended Rockford Public Schools.
West holds a B.S. from Illinois College and an M.A. from the Chicago School of Professional Psychology.
West is also described as an ordained minister and a music producer who founded Music With Pleasure, LLC.
